method: 20 queries, top 10 results each from scripts/x402_prices/recall_check.mjs (same MiniSearch settings as the Price comps page), judged relevant or not by ClCo reading the normalised 'what it does' + host.
decision: Keyword + category retrieval is good enough; no embeddings. Weak spot: ambiguous words ('scores' matched financial scores). Fix shipped: at most 3 comparables per seller, because single hosts listed 8 of the top 10 for some queries and would dominate the price distribution.
caveat: This measures precision of the top 10, not true recall (we cannot enumerate every relevant listing by hand).
